notes: All six pages are Common Crawl captures (Oct 2019) of Columbia Business School "Programs » Doctoral » Dissertations" filtered by year (2009-2014). Each entry gives dissertation title, "Name, Year" and "Faculty Advisor"; no placement, position or degree is stated, so destination/position/degree are null. The page does not say whether the year is the dissertation/graduation year, so yearMeaning is "unstated". Program is recorded as "Doctoral" (the breadcrumb label); the page does not name a department or field per person; the field can be inferred only from advisor/title, which was not done. The 2010, 2011 and 2014 captures end with "1 of 2 / Older items": a second results page exists for those years and is not in this chunk, so those year lists are incomplete. Woo-Jin Chang appears on both the 2009 and the 2010 lists with the same dissertation (title truncated on the 2009 page: "...Following SFAS"; the 2010 page gives "...Following SFAS 158"). The integrator should reconcile the year. Meng Li (2013) has an empty Faculty Advisor field on the page. Two 2014 entries list two advisors: Fikret Caner Gocman (Garrett van Ryzin, Robert Phillips) and Yonatan Gur (Omar Besbes, Assaf Zeevi).
